items.t: Trump stakes his fortunes on Nvidia after Huang's return
items.d: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia chief after White House pressure, and has told staff he is in therapy. Critics say Trump has now tied himself to the chipmaker's fate.

items.t: Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets in US trial
items.d: A New York jury convicted Huawei of trade-secret theft but cleared it of racketeering after a months-long trial, a blow to the Chinese tech giant amid US-China tensions.

items.t: Putin vows to hit back over Ukraine's energy strikes
items.d: Putin said Russia will respond to Ukrainian attacks on its fuel and power sites, which continue despite Trump's call to stop. Russia said it struck three Ukrainian substations.

items.t: Solomon Islands drops China pact for Australia treaty
items.d: The Pacific nation ended its controversial 2022 security deal with Beijing in favour of a new treaty with Australia, a notable shift in regional influence.

items.t: Houthis hit Riyadh's tallest tower again, 11 hurt
items.d: Saudi Arabia says Yemen's Houthis attacked the Public Investment Fund tower for the second time in a week, injuring at least 11 people.

items.t: Kilmar Ábrego García to leave US for Spain
items.d: The man wrongly deported to El Salvador and later returned will move to Spain, ending a case that became a symbol of fights over Trump's immigration policy.

items.t: Sarkozy and Carla Bruni ordered to stand trial
items.d: France's former president and his wife will face trial in another legal case; Sarkozy became the first ex-president to go to jail last year.

items.t: Nasdaq slides as money rotates out of AI; Dow tops 50,000
items.d: Nasdaq fell about 1.5% as Nvidia and other AI stocks dropped, while the Dow rose about 0.9% to a record above 50,000 as investors moved into value and healthcare stocks.

items.t: US consumer confidence jumps far beyond forecasts
items.d: The Conference Board index rose 11.4 points to 103.3 in November, well above the 92.2 expected, a boost for spending heading into the holiday season.

items.t: Hong Kong power bills to rise, HK Electric up 7.9%
items.d: Hong Kong's two power companies set next year's tariffs: HK Electric customers face a 7.9% rise and CLP customers 1.8%.

items.t: Huang faces Congress grilling next month on Nvidia
items.d: US lawmakers plan a public hearing in early December where Huang is expected to answer on Nvidia's governance and chip exports. Trump says his return poses no security risk.

items.t: DeepMind AI agents find faster quantum algorithms
items.d: Google DeepMind says its agents, checked by formal verification, found quantum algorithms for fusion research that cut estimated computing cost nearly 12-fold.

items.t: NHS starts huge AI breast-screening trial
items.d: Nearly 700,000 women will take part over three years to test whether AI can spot breast cancer earlier and speed up reading of mammograms.

items.t: Google patent imagines AI TV shows starring you
items.d: A Google patent application describes personalised AI-generated episodes featuring a digital double of the viewer. No product has been announced.

items.t: Hong Kong's Gleneagles Hospital reports patient data leak
items.d: The private hospital says patient data was leaked and has notified the authorities, the latest in a string of data breaches at Hong Kong organisations.

items.t: Record 5,200 heat-linked deaths in England this year
items.d: UKHSA estimates this year's heat-related deaths were double the previous record, a stark sign of how hotter summers are hitting health.

items.t: Moon far-side rocks point to violent early solar system
items.d: Analysis of rocks from the Moon's far side suggests the young solar system saw more violent impacts than thought, reshaping theories of how planets formed.

items.t: Ancient oceans may have misled scientists on oxygen
items.d: New research suggests chemical clues in old ocean rocks may give a misleading timeline of when Earth's air became oxygen-rich, a key question for early life.

items.t: Ofgem to reveal January price cap as gas costs surge
items.d: The regulator announces the new cap today, with household gas prices expected to rise significantly from January, piling on winter cost-of-living pressure.

items.t: Burnham orders independent panel for nuclear test veterans
items.d: The PM promised veterans of Britain's Cold War nuclear tests the full truth, with a Hillsborough-style panel examining the programme's health legacy.

items.t: Firms backing Ukraine warned of Russian sabotage
items.d: A UK security alert told businesses supporting Ukraine to act now against rising risks of arson, sabotage and threats to staff.

items.t: 特朗普助黃仁勳回巢 政治前途與Nvidia掛鈎
items.d: 黃仁勳在白宮施壓下重掌Nvidia，並向員工透露正接受心理治療。批評者指特朗普的政治命運已與這家晶片巨企綁在一起。

items.t: 華為美國案被裁盜竊商業機密罪成
items.d: 紐約陪審團經數月審訊後，裁定華為盜竊商業機密等罪成，但敲詐勒索罪名不成立，在中美角力下對華為是一大打擊。

items.t: 普京誓言回應烏克蘭襲擊能源設施
items.d: 普京表示，烏克蘭不顧特朗普要求繼續襲擊俄羅斯燃料及能源設施，俄方必定回應。俄軍稱已以無人機襲擊烏克蘭三個變電站。

items.t: 所羅門群島棄中國安全協議 改簽澳洲條約
items.d: 這個太平洋島國終止與北京具爭議的安全協議，改與澳洲簽訂新條約，顯示區內影響力出現明顯轉變。

items.t: 胡塞武裝再襲利雅得最高大廈 最少11傷
items.d: 沙特指也門胡塞武裝一星期內第二度襲擊利雅得公共投資基金大廈，最少11人受傷。

items.t: 阿夫雷戈加西亞將離美赴西班牙
items.d: 這名曾被錯誤遣返薩爾瓦多、其後獲送回美國的男子將移居西班牙，為這宗象徵特朗普移民政策爭議的案件畫上句號。

items.t: 薩爾科齊與妻子布妮將受審
items.d: 法國前總統薩爾科齊及妻子布妮將在另一宗案件中受審；薩爾科齊去年成為首位入獄的法國前總統。

items.t: 資金撤離AI股 納指跌 道指破五萬點
items.d: Nvidia等AI股下跌，納斯達克指數跌約1.5%；資金轉投價值股及醫療股，道指升約0.9%，創新高升穿五萬點。

items.t: 美國消費者信心大幅高於預期
items.d: 世界大型企業研究會11月消費者信心指數急升11.4點至103.3，遠高於預期的92.2，有利節日消費。

items.t: 港燈明年電費加7.9% 中電加1.8%
items.d: 本港兩電公布明年電費，港燈平均淨電價加7.9%，中電加1.8%。

items.t: 黃仁勳下月須赴國會作證
items.d: 美國國會下月初舉行公開聽證會，預料要求黃仁勳交代Nvidia管治及晶片出口問題。特朗普稱他復職不構成國家安全風險。

items.t: DeepMind AI代理找出更快量子演算法
items.d: Google DeepMind表示，其AI代理配合形式驗證，為核聚變研究找到更高效的量子演算法，估計運算成本減少近12倍。

items.t: 英國展開大型AI乳癌篩查試驗
items.d: 近70萬名女性將在三年內參與試驗，測試AI能否更早發現乳癌及加快分析乳房X光片。

items.t: Google專利構想由你主演的AI電視劇
items.d: Google一份專利申請描述以AI生成個人化劇集，並由觀眾的數碼分身演出，但公司未有宣布任何產品。

items.t: 港怡醫院報告病人資料外洩
items.d: 港怡醫院表示有病人資料外洩，已通知當局，是本港機構接連發生的資料外洩事故之一。

items.t: 英格蘭今年估計5200人死於炎熱天氣
items.d: 英國衞生安全局估計，今年與炎熱有關的死亡人數是以往紀錄的兩倍，反映夏季愈來愈熱對健康的衝擊。

items.t: 月球背面岩石揭示早期太陽系更動盪
items.d: 分析月球背面岩石樣本後，科學家認為早期太陽系經歷的撞擊比想像中更猛烈，或改寫行星形成理論。

items.t: 古代海洋或誤導科學家對氧氣史判斷
items.d: 新研究指，古代海洋岩石中的化學線索可能令科學家誤判地球大氣何時變得富氧，這是研究早期生命的關鍵問題。

items.t: Ofgem今公布一月能源價格上限 氣價急升
items.d: 能源監管機構今日公布新價格上限，預料家庭燃氣價格明年一月起大幅上升，加重冬季生活開支壓力。

items.t: 賓咸成立獨立小組調查核試老兵健康
items.d: 首相賓咸承諾向參與冷戰時期核試的老兵交代全部真相，將仿照希斯堡慘劇模式成立獨立小組，調查核試對健康的影響。

items.t: 支援烏克蘭企業獲警告提防俄羅斯破壞
items.d: 英國發出安全警報，促支援烏克蘭的企業立即加強防範，應對縱火、破壞及員工受威脅等風險上升。
